title: How to Design a Professional YouTube Thumbnail With AI
description: Learn how to design eye-catching YouTube thumbnails using AI tools.
prompt: Create a high-CTR YouTube thumbnail, 1280x720px, bold 3D text with the title in the center, dramatic lighting, vibrant red-blue-orange gradient background with circuit/tech lines, a subject on the left pointing at the title, glowing neon outline effect, professional YouTube thumbnail style, ultra sharp, 4k.

title: How to Write a Viral YouTube Shorts Script
description: Learn how to use AI to write a 30-second viral Shorts script that boosts watch time.
prompt: Write a 30-second viral YouTube Shorts script about [TOPIC]. Hook the viewer in the first 3 seconds with a bold question or shocking fact, keep sentences short and punchy, include a mid-video re-hook, and end with a strong call-to-action to follow the channel. Format the output as: HOOK, BODY (3 short beats), CTA.

title: Video Editing With Smooth Transitions
description: Learn how to add smooth, professional transitions in CapCut and Premiere Pro.
prompt: Act as a professional video editor. Suggest 5 smooth transition ideas (with exact effect names for CapCut and Premiere Pro) suited for a fast-paced tutorial video, including timing (in frames/seconds) and the mood each transition creates.
